content:
PhD Census estimates in India 

1950-2000 : ~2.3 lakh ~17K (engineering)
1950-2010 : ~4 lakh ~40K (engineering)
1950-2020 : ~6 lakh ~1.4L (engineering) and 50000 from IIT/NIT etc.

Question is "why we weren't able to utilize those 50000 researchers in India" ?
comment: The missing link may not be talent but translation. Research ecosystems need industry funding, commercialization pathways, and incentives to turn academic work into products, patents, and scalable solutions.
